items.title: Lucy Dacus Joins Madi Diaz On New Version Of “Heavy Metal”
items.summary: The great singer-songwriters Madi Diaz and Lucy Dacus just had a big weekend together at the Newport Folk Festival. Diaz and Dacus both performed at Newport, and Dacus did a guest-heavy set that included appearances from Hayley Williams, Brandon Flowers, and — hey, look at that — Madi Diaz.

items.title: Chris Gantry Announces New Album Worth Every Nail: Hear “Boldness Of Spirit”
items.summary: In his later years, Nashville-based outlaw country legend Chris Gantry has experienced a resurgence with assistance from the community surrounding Chicago indie fixture Drag City Records. In 2017, Drag City reissued Gantry's lost album At The House Of Cash. In 2019, we shared "Box Of Crayons," his Bill Callahan collab from the Jerry David DeCicca-produced Nashlantis.

items.title: Carly Simon Reveals Parkinson’s Disease And Cancer Diagnoses That Spurred First New Album In 18 Years
items.summary: The veteran singer-songwriter Carly Simon hasn't performed live since a 2018 Tibet House benefit at Carnegie Hall, and she hasn't released an album of new songs since 2008's This Kind Of Love. She did not attend her Rock And Roll Hall Of Fame induction in 2022.
